title: Kawasaki Heavy Industries bets JPY550 billion on physical AI, robotics
notes: No article body obtained: the Digitimes page is members-only and shows one opening sentence, which says Kawasaki Heavy Industries is betting on physical AI as part of a multibillion-dollar growth plan to modernize factories, address labor shortages and expand robotics across shipbuilding, aerospace and healthcare. Google News searches in English and Japanese found no other outlet carrying the 550 billion yen figure (other Kawasaki robotics stories from 3-9 Oct 2026 do not mention it), so the entry is a cautious restatement with attribution. key_facts left empty because the facts could not be read.
